csv_project_name: AE for Large Scale Public Infrastructure Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: Fourth Ward Redevelopment Authority invites the submission of a Statement of Qualifications (''SOQ'') from interested firms to provide professional architectural and engineering ("A&E'') services for the implementation of the FWRA Capital Improvement Plan (CIP). The FWRA Capital Improvement Plan (''CIP") details current and future spending on large scale public infrastructure improvements ranging from additional new street reconstruction to future park land development. The public infrastructure upgrades are targeted independent of new development projects, allowing FWRA to physically improve areas within the boundaries of the Fourth Ward Zone that may need special attention and areas ready for new development.
